recipes.oracle_text: Roast deals 5 damage to target creature without flying.

recipe_coverage: Targeted damage component: exact normal payment, legality, real responses, ordered stocked zones, cleanup, and AI/snapshot replay. Additional abilities (alternate costs, graveyard casting, planeswalkers, uncounterability, damage prevention, equipment destruction, regeneration prohibition) require separate authored cases where present.
